notes: Carbonator pressure-vessel end cap — 3D model for CNC machining quotes (Xometry / Protolabs / Fictiv / RapidDirect). The complete machined part: 123.4 mm dia x 6.35 mm (4.860 in x 1/4 in) disc, two 1/4-18 NPT ports at 7/16 in (11.13 mm) tap-drill THRU, and the blind level-sensing rod register (9/64 in / 3.572 mm dia, 0.100 in / 2.54 mm deep) on the inside (+Z) face, leaving 3.81 mm of plate as pressure boundary. One geometry serves both caps. The production part is laser-cut flat per endcap-circular-2hole.dxf, then NPT-tapped and the register drilled in-house on the WEN 4208T; the laser file omits the register because a laser can't make a blind pocket without breaching the 90 PSI boundary. 316L for the welded build per assembly/pressure-vessel.md.
